pages.text: Right-click a patient with an item to treat them, right-click the air to treat yourself. The body part is picked automatically (the one in most need) or by dragging in the $(l)H$() panel.

Treatment is a $(l)minigame$(): the better you play, the better the result. If the server turns minigames off in combat, then in combat (damage within $(cfg)30$() s) — a progress bar only.$(br2)The "No minigame" button or Esc — a progress bar $(cfg)2$() times longer, with more mistakes.

If the treatment is not needed, you get a refusal. Repeat it within 5 seconds to do it anyway, with consequences (a tourniquet on a healthy leg, an extra dose).$(br2)Items above your level can still be used, but each missing level adds $(cfg)+30%$() error chance, up to $(cfg)85%$(). Mistakes hurt.
